name: Tank
about: Takes hits and hits back. Gains energy from being hit.

E.name: Shield
E.about: Soaks up the next 60 damage (16s). Lasts twice as long while you stand still.

F.name: Thorns Aura
F.about: Three rings that hurt and taunt: inner x2 damage, middle x1, outer x0.5. Attackers take back half their hit. Lasts twice as long while you stand still.
